scripts.deploy:check: npx tsx libs/cli/src/bin/craft-ts.ts check --config apps/demo/craft.deploy.ts --provider github-pages --artifact && npx tsx libs/cli/src/bin/craft-ts.ts check --config apps/demo-ssr/craft.deploy.ts --provider docker --artifact
scripts.deploy:manifest: npx tsx libs/cli/src/bin/craft-ts.ts manifest --config apps/demo/craft.deploy.ts --out dist/apps/demo/craft-deployment-manifest.json && npx tsx libs/cli/src/bin/craft-ts.ts manifest --config apps/demo-ssr/craft.deploy.ts --out dist/apps/demo-ssr/craft-deployment-manifest.json
scripts.security:test: npx vitest run --config libs/core/vitest.config.ts security/ && npx vitest run --config libs/component/vitest.config.ts security/ && npx vitest run --config libs/dev-tools/vitest.config.mts src/eslint-rules/security.spec.ts
scripts.production:check: npm run build:production && node tools/production-smoke.mjs dist/apps/demo dist/apps/demo-effect dist/apps/quickstart-effect dist/apps/demo-with-server-function dist/apps/demo-ssr && npm run deploy:check && npm run deploy:manifest && node tools/production-http-smoke.mjs
scripts.demo:ssr:production: nx run demo-ssr:build:production && nx run demo-ssr:start-production
scripts.release:preflight: nx run-many --targets=typecheck,typecheck-manifests,lint,architecture,effect-check --all --skipSync --outputStyle=stream && nx test docs && npm run security:check && npm run security:test && npm run production:check
scripts.release:check: npm run release:preflight && node --test tools/release.test.mjs tools/release-local.test.mjs
